MWAS is computed from all positive off-diagonal intermediate transactions in the 2018 transaction table; there is no transaction cutoff in the optimization. The ordering is a multi-start insertion-search heuristic for the maximum-weight acyclic subgraph, because exact MWAS is NP-hard. The retained backbone is explicitly verified to be a DAG.
